questions.q: What is the essence of the "Get home without help" experiment?
o: His wife takes the author to an unfamiliar place, and he has to get home without a map or the internet
The author looks for a treasure
questions.e: In the video: "Ona će mene da odvede gde god hoće, a ja treba da se vratim kući bez mape, interneta i bez ičije pomoći" — she will take me wherever she wants, and I have to get back home without a map, internet or anyone's help.

questions.q: How does the author get home?
questions.e: In the video: "Bajs... Koji sam"; he pedals all the way ("vergla" — pedaling hard).

questions.q: How does his wife keep track of him?
o: By a tracker in his bag
questions.e: In the video: "U mojoj torbi se nalazio traker i Goca je mogla da pogleda u svakom trenutku gde se ja nalazim" — there was a tracker in my bag, and Goca could see at any moment where I was.

questions.q: What does the author look for in order to get his bearings?
questions.e: In the video: "planirao sam da dođem do reke i onda skontam da je to Sava ili Dunav i automatski znam gde je Beograd" — I planned to get to the river and then figure out whether it's the Sava or the Danube, and automatically know where Belgrade is.

questions.q: What did he find instead of a river?
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam našao jezero. Odakle ovde jezero?" — I found a lake. Where did a lake come from here?

questions.q: What bothered him the most on the Sava bank?
questions.e: In the video: "Imam problem zato što me komarci grizu čim stanem na 5 sekundi" and "Truckavi putevi su me ubijali" — I have a problem because mosquitoes bite me as soon as I stop for 5 seconds, and the bumpy roads were killing me.

questions.q: Who found him in the evening?
o: His wife Goca, who came by car to the café
questions.e: In the video: "Goca je videla na mapi da sam prestao da se pomeram... došla je autom da vidi šta se dešava sa mnom" — Goca saw on the map that I had stopped moving... she came by car to see what was happening with me.

questions.q: How close was he to New Belgrade when he gave up?
questions.e: In the video: "Evo ga Novi Beograd. Znači, maksimalno 20 minuta sam imao" — there's New Belgrade. So I had 20 minutes at most.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: *Zavezan* sam za drvo, ne znam gde se nalazim.
questions.e: Zavezan — tied, bound.

questions.q: Nisam osetio *uzbrdo*.
questions.e: Uzbrdo — up a slope.

questions.q: Na drugoj *raskrsnici* mene ljudi pitaju gde je neko mesto.
questions.e: Raskrsnica — an intersection.

questions.q: Ovo je *nasip*, da se ovo ne potopi od reke.
questions.e: Nasip — an embankment, a dam.

questions.q: Pored Save sam došao do *ćorsokaka*.
questions.e: Ćorsokak — a dead end.

questions.q: Popio bih sad vodu iz *lokve*.
questions.e: Lokva — a puddle.

questions.q: Vode mi je ostalo dva *gutljaja*.
questions.e: Gutljaj — a sip.

questions.q: Sava *krivuda*.
questions.e: Krivudati — to meander; kriv — crooked.

questions.q: Ja se uvek fleksujem svojoj ___.
questions.e: Fleksovati se to someone — dative case: svojoj ženi.

questions.q: Treba da se vratim ___ bez mape i interneta.
questions.e: Vratiti se kući — "to return home", the form kući.

questions.q: Bez ___, interneta i bez ičije pomoći.
questions.e: Bez ("without") requires the genitive case: bez mape.

questions.q: Sedim u ___ i nisam osetio da auto ide gore-dole.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case; kola is always plural: u kolima.

questions.q: Izvinite, u kom ___ je Beograd?
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u kom pravcu.

questions.q: Moja intuicija do sada nije bila u ___.
questions.e: To be right — the expression biti u pravu.

questions.q: Nadao sam se da ću ___ neku zgradu,
questions.e: Hoping for a result — "to catch sight of": perfective videti. Gledati is imperfective (process).

questions.q: Znači, ipak idu u ovom ___ smeru.
questions.e: U + locative. Smer is masculine, so drugom smeru.
